snippets.text: Although Balanus, Hydroides and Teredo become sexually mature and spawn during their first season when they are only two months old, they spawn most abundantly during their second season when they are one year of age. Each of them spawns several times during the second summer.Bugula, Botryllus and various hydroids, on the other hand, spawn principally before they are two months old and it is doubtful if they ever survive for a full year.
